title: poa bulbosa subsp. nevskii
intro: Poa bulbosa subsp. nevskii, commonly known as Nevskii's bluegrass, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, such as respiratory problems and gastrointestinal disorders, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Poa bulbosa subsp. nevskii include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight against infections, and promote digestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
